decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, so management can still blame its quiet profile on slow ramp-up, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises doubts.
As a multi-variant line, the spicy cheese ties up the most invested resources and shelf commitment, which favours persisting with it despite little visible promotion.
The mild soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new cheese range, and that visible commitment calls for justifying it with more time, even though it has not been visible since.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche and least promoted item, and after the firm has already shown it will drop even a flagship, sunk costs no longer justify keeping a product that has disappeared from view.
